title: Which rotation can be discarded?
hook: Which rotation can be discarded? Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Find the lexicographically smallest string rotation by skipping a run of losing candidates after a mismatch.

misconception: Every cyclic rotation must be built and sorted separately.
objective: Find the lexicographically smallest string rotation by skipping a run of losing candidates after a mismatch.

claims.text: At a mismatch, the losing candidate and its matched-prefix neighbours can be skipped together. The candidate jumps preserve the minimum rotation without sorting or explicitly storing every rotation.
